prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多级表头 · 半年度指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "指标" spans 1 col × 2 row; "2023 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "2024 年" spans 2 col × 1 row; "备注" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 107px
  col 2: header "2023 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 40px
  col 3: header "2023 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 40px
  col 4: header "2024 年 › 上半年" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 40px
  col 5: header "2024 年 › 下半年" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 40px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 303px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 516px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 515px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按半年度比较三项经营指标在 2023 年和 2024 年的变化，并结合备注理解原因。","reading":"读者先通过指标名称定位行，再横向比较四个半年度的数值，最后阅读该行备注；也可纵向扫描同一半年的不同指标。","groups":["第 2–3 列同属 2023 年，第 4–5 列同属 2024 年；四列都是半年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和比较节奏。","第 1 列是行标题，第 6 列是解释性备注，分别承担识别和说明作用。"],"keep_intact":["四个半年度标题及其数值，包括百分号和小数。","指标名称中的数字、单位和括号应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["备注中的中文说明可自然换行，并利用同一行已有的高度。","指标名称可在词组边界换行，但应保持名称与单位的关系清楚。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [85, 61, 61, 61, 61, 186] · table 516×207px · row heights [33, 33, 53, 33, 53] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [128, 61, 61, 61, 61, 143] · table 516×207px · row heights [33, 33, 73, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"四个半年度列等宽，表头和数字完整，横向比较节奏清楚。备注列较宽，较长说明只需两行。","problems":"营业收入和研发投入的名称与单位分成两行，使两行都偏高；第一列文字显得拥挤。","cause":"第一列宽 85px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有 64px，放不下带单位的完整指标名称；186px 的备注列则占用了较多宽度。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"指标名称及单位均保持一行，第一列清晰；四个半年度列等宽，数字便于比较。","problems":"首行备注被挤成三行，造成该行明显高于其余数据行，首行数值下方留白较多，整体节奏不均。","cause":"第一列增至 128px 后，备注列降至 143px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有 122px，长备注需要三行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[107,61,61,61,61,164],"change":"在两种方案之间重新分配第一列与备注列的宽度。四个半年度列保持等宽，争取让指标名称更从容，同时让首行备注维持两行。"},{"name":"labels-first","widths":[120,61,61,61,61,151],"change":"优先保留完整指标名称，并比 r2B 多给备注列 8px，检验能否减少首行备注的换行，缓和行高差。"},{"name":"notes-first","widths":[96,61,61,61,61,175],"change":"保留较宽的备注列，同时比 r2A 多给指标列 11px，检验能否改善名称与单位的换行位置，保持两行备注的舒展感。"}]}
